The momentary junction of feveral tribes produces an army: their more latting union contitutes a nation; and the fupreme chief, the emir of emirs, whole banner is diplayed at their head, may deferve, in the eyes of ftrangers, the honours of the kingly name. If the Arabian princes abufe their power, they are quickly punished by the defertion of their subjects, who had been accutlomed to a mild and parental jurisdiction. Their spirit is free, their fleps are unconfined; the defart is open, and the tribes and families are held together by a mutual and voluntary compact.
